description: Update the company profile (name, description, useCases, accounts) or override the classifier context directly. Profile edits recompose the context; an explicit context wins until the next profile edit. The context is the single biggest lever on relevance scoring, so keep it accurate and specific; it does not reach keywords in a group with its own description (update_group for those). Omitted fields are untouched.

competitors.description: Replaces the whole list; [] clears it.

context.description: Overrides the composed context until the next profile edit.

guidelines.description: Free-text rules for the classifier; null clears them.

website.description: The company website; null clears it.

name: update_company
title: Update company
